personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, masculine command center for workshop operations, driven by stark readability and industrial orange accents.

spacing.rule: Use compact spacing for high information density, typical of command centers.

dont's: No glassmorphism. This is a brutal, high-utility dark theme. Use solid surfaceSecondary for elevation and dividers for structure.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Onboard users with a toggle to choose between Client or Workshop view.

states.loading: Dark spinner over the login button.
states.error: Inline red text below the affected input.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top taking 40% height with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim (stop at 80% opacity) ensuring seamless merge into the surface color. Display title in Oswald over the scrim. Below, a Segmented Control (toggle) for Client/Workshop, followed by single-column inputs. Sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Meus Veículos
screens.purpose: Display a list of registered cars and allow adding a new one via modal.

states.empty: Illustration/Icon of an empty garage with 'Nenhum veículo cadastrado' and a primary 'Adicionar Veículo' button.

screens.layout: Vertical FlatList. Each card (surfaceSecondary) has a vehicle placeholder image/silhouette, model name (Oswald), plate, year, and KM (tabular font, muted). Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right anchored above the safe area, tinted in brandPrimary, to trigger a Bottom Sheet for adding a new vehicle.

screens.name: Agenda do Dia
screens.purpose: Workshop's daily view to manage appointments with quick actions and status.
screens.layout: Sticky header with current date. Scrollable list with a timeline layout: time on the left (Oswald, muted), vertical separator, and a surfaceSecondary card on the right. Card includes vehicle details, a status badge (warning for 'Agendado', success for 'Confirmado', brandSecondary for 'Em Andamento'). Pending cards include side-by-side 'Confirmar' (surfaceTertiary) and 'Recusar' (border outline) buttons.

login_hero.alt: Dark moody garage workshop interior with tools

vehicle_placeholder.alt: Sleek sports car silhouette on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (Personality 7) guidelines. Do not use blue or purple anywhere; keep the interface sharp and masculine.
Implement the 'Agenda do Dia' timeline layout carefully: align times on the left using a tabular or condensed font (Oswald), keeping the UI scannable.
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weight (either all filled or all outlined depending on the active state).
For the Login screen hero image, ensure the gradient scrim is vertical (transparent -> 80% surfaceInverse/black) so the text is fully readable.
The add vehicle action should use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Ensure the form has standard spacing and sticky bottom CTA.
Badges in Agenda must use the designated status colors from the JSON, keeping contrast readable on the dark surface.
No glassmorphism for this app. Use solid colors and dividers for elevation.
